messages:
incident-bot: *INCIDENT* prefix-cache hit-rate drop detected in prod-us-west · severity P2 · 2026-03-15T03:12:34Z. Paging on-call and SREs.

sara (oncall): ack, I'm on it. grabbing baseline metrics and checking recent deploys.

scout (cs): seeing customer reports of slow completions (not errors) for search/prefix endpoints. tagging top accounts now. :eyes:

dennis (sre): looked at cache metrics — global prefix hitrate fell from ~92% to ~28% between 03:07 and 03:09Z. KV eviction rate spiked at 03:10Z. Looks like a mass invalidation or key mismatch.

jaya (ml-eng): checking deploy history. deploy-bot shows model-serving/config deploy at 03:07:52Z to prod-us-west, link: https://deploys.internal/release/2402

ops-bot: deploy-bot: "deploy: model-serving v2.14 -> prod-us-west" at 03:07:52Z (triggered by pipeline #2402).

todd (infra): there was a scheduled reindex job on logs-service at 03:06:50Z which generated a lot of write IO; could have caused eviction pressure if cache connectors were backfilled.

sara (oncall): initial hypothesis A — reindex or background job caused memory pressure leading to evictions + rewarm lag. hypothesis B — deploy changed prefix key format causing misses. Need timeline and logs.

dennis (sre): searching request traces for delimiter changes. found large volume of keys with '|' delimiter appearing at 03:08:00Z onward. Existing delimiter has been ':' historically. Example diff from instrumentation: 

```diff
- prefixKey(userId, prefix) => `${userId}:${prefix}`
+ prefixKey(userId, prefix) => `${userId}|${prefix}`
```

dennis (sre): grep of live logs shows ~500k requests using '|' starting 03:08:00Z, exactly after the deploy timestamp.

jaya (ml-eng): model-serving config shows 'prefixDelimiter' toggled. Paste from config store: 

```
[03:07:58Z] deploy-bot: applied config v2.14
[03:08:01Z] main: prefixDelimiter set to '|'
```

sara (oncall): customer impact summary so far — median latency for prefix endpoints +250ms, p95 up ~1.8s. Error rates not elevated but tail latencies spike. This matches cache miss behavior.

todd (infra): mitigation option: flip feature flag 'useNewDelimiter' to false to restore ':' behavior. Will that be safe?

jaya (ml-eng): rollback of delimiter is safe; new delimiter wasn't backwards compatible. +1 to toggle rollback.

sara (oncall): executing rollback now: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/prefix-cache --env=USE_NEW_DELIM=false` — will monitor warming.

ops-bot: rollout started, new env applied to deploy/prefix-cache, pods restarting.

dennis (sre): observing hitrate numbers recovering after rollback. sample timeline: 

```text
03:09:00 hitrate 28%
03:11:00 hitrate 65%
03:14:00 hitrate 89%
```

sara (oncall): status page draft: "We experienced increased latency for prefix lookups caused by a configuration change that altered cache key format; rollback is in progress and latency is improving." @scout can you post?

scout (cs): posted status and emailed top-20 affected accounts. Customers acknowledged update.

sara (oncall): next action items for RCA: 1) assemble timeline and correlate deploys + jobs + evictions, 2) collect rewarm logs and KV eviction traces, 3) reproduce mismatch locally, 4) owner for postmortem.

jaya (ml-eng): I'll reproduce key-format guard in a local harness and add unit/regression tests to CI to prevent delimiter regressions.

dennis (sre): I'll collate eviction logs, rewarm logs, and tracing spans into an artifact. saving logs bundle: https://logs.internal/bundles/incident-2003456789 (will include rewarm latencies and eviction counts).

todd (infra): I'll add a CI pre-deploy check to diff serialized cache keys and reject changes that alter delimiter without a compatibility migration.

sara (oncall): assigning postmortem to dennis (sre). ETA draft 24h, final RCAs + action items 72h.

sara (oncall): hitrates back above 90% and latency normalized. Closing live incident at 03:20Z. Follow-up thread will include full timeline and root cause write-up. :white_check_mark:
